review: No chorus field; single 12-line stanza. This hymn duplicates book3/6 (أخذتك المحبة يا حبيب), whose rendering is reused verbatim, split back into the main's 12 printed lines (book3 prints six lines of two half-phrases each). نִדְקְרוּ for سُمِّرت and נִמְסְרוּ for the Arabic's own سُلِّمت pair follow book3/6's review note; מָסְרוּךָ for وسلمتك, יָדִيد for يا حبيب, צְלָב for الصليب. The final book3 line בְּעוֹלָם הַנֶּצַח בִּשְׁמֵי מְעוֹנֶךָ is split into 1:11 and 1:12 to match the main print.
